fullstack.headline: Backend Software Engineer · .NET & Python
fullstack.summary: Backend software engineer working with .NET and Python. I build APIs, integrations, and internal systems that replace paid tools — and take them all the way to production.

dotnet.headline: .NET Backend Developer | APIs & integrations
dotnet.summary: I build APIs and integrations in C# with ASP.NET Core (Web API and Minimal APIs) and EF Core, documented with Swagger and following SOLID. I own the full cycle: contract design, automated tests, Docker, and automated deploys with GitHub Actions.

python.headline: Python Developer | Automation & data
python.summary: Developer with strong Python experience for automation, integrations, and data pipelines. I work with BigQuery, SQL, and APIs — from prototype to production — prioritizing clear code, observability, and continuous delivery.

react.headline: Front-end Developer | React & TypeScript
react.summary: Front-end developer with React and TypeScript, including React Native. I build dynamic, responsive, product-oriented interfaces — from Figma to code — with attention to accessibility, performance, and API integration.

backend.headline: Backend Developer | APIs & distributed systems
backend.summary: Backend developer focused on APIs, integrations, and messaging-based services (RabbitMQ). I work with .NET and Python, PostgreSQL and BigQuery, Docker, and GCP — and I care about cost and performance as much as features.
